Yone.build: If the enemy team also has an assassin, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so building only one type of resistance isn’t enough. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Yone.teamfight: From behind your frontline, stop Yone’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Spread out so several allies aren’t hit together by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and make sure you aren’t alone at the very back of Yone R Fate Sealed’s path. Use Lux R Final Spark to pierce grouped enemies or secure a certain kill.
Yone.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don’t detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away, so you can consume the Lux P Illumination mark with two basic attacks. Lux R Final Spark has a cast delay, so chain it to hit before Lux Q Light Binding wears off.
Yone.escape: The window to engage is before Yone R Fate Sealed is ready again. If only Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone E Soul Unbound is down, he can escape with his remaining mobility, so check his other movement options before landing Lux Q Light Binding. Rooting Yone when he comes in in spirit form can also prevent him from returning to his body.
Yone.fight: Usually, poke from the edge of your range with Lux E Lucent Singularity and use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding until you can stop Yone’s engage or set up a kill. If Yone comes in in spirit form, you can root him with Lux Q Light Binding to prevent his return.
Yone.laning: When Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready, stop pressuring him and keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Check bushes without vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and don’t drain your mana by casting it whenever it’s off cooldown.
Yone.phase: In the late game, prioritize positioning over damage, since Lux has no ability to escape if Yone catches her.
Yone.watch: When Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, watch for his tornado to become ready. Stay out of range while it’s ready and keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are also engage tools, so don’t use Lux Q Light Binding hastily.

Janna.fight: Poke Janna’s protected ally with Lux E Lucent Singularity to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Once the shield is gone, follow up with your damage. If Janna is isolated, look for an angle to catch her with Lux Q Light Binding. Don’t immediately unleash burst damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.
Janna.laning: Detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then poke with a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop an engage. If you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Use E to check bushes without vision.
Janna.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Janna.combo: After the shield from Janna E Eye Of The Storm is gone, bind the target with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Janna.escape: After Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr have been wasted is your chance to catch Janna with Lux Q Light Binding. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, she can knock back anyone who approaches, so check whether she has used it before starting a fight.
Janna.phase: In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst gets stronger as she builds ability power. In the late game, prioritize a safe position over damage.
Janna.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block routes with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward the clustered allies to block damage. Avoid targets protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. If Janna is isolated or several enemies line up, look for an angle with Lux Q Light Binding and Lux R Final Spark.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks you airborne, so if you hear the tornado from out of sight, move out of its path. Janna W Zephyr slows you and makes it hard to keep your distance, so don’t waste Lux Q Light Binding; save it. Janna R Monsoon knocks nearby enemies back and heals them, so don’t force an engage while it’s available.

Akshan.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Akshan’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a sure finish. If you’re marked as the Scoundrel, don’t face Akshan alone and fight outside his execute range.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical and Lux has low armor, so build armor first. Hold on early with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: Bind Akshan with Lux Q Light Binding after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down. Keep Lux E Lucent Singularity placed, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his means of mobility, so right after he uses it is your chance to close the gap and bind him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Akshan.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Akshan E Heroic Swing as he comes in or to bind him after that ability is down.
Akshan.laning: Lux has no mobility and has low armor and health, so fight at maximum range. Don’t stay only behind the minion wave to dodge Akshan Q Avengerang; watch its return path too. Before entering a brush you have no vision of, check it with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, Akshan can get on top of you, so prioritize positioning over damage.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits an enemy, so dodge its outbound and return paths even from behind a minion wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing dashes using walls, so keep Lux Q Light Binding ready to stop his engage near walls. If Akshan R Comeuppance’s targeting indicator appears while your health is low, move behind terrain.

Aurora.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at max range and use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check brush with no vision. E costs a lot of mana, so don't cast it every time it's off cooldown. If you're playing support and need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with E; overlap the minion wave only when you need to push.
Aurora.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Aurora's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. If Aurora dives in but no one is killed, that's a chance to catch her with Q. If Aurora participates in a kill, her leap ability's cooldown resets, so don't leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Aurora.combo: When you have a chance to kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate E → basic attack.
Aurora.escape: If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding is down, account for her other mobility tool. If Aurora R Between Worlds isn't back yet and she has used both mobility tools in succession, that's a chance to catch her with Lux Q Light Binding.
Aurora.fight: Trades with Aurora become less favorable as health decreases, so poke from max range with Lux E Lucent Singularity and consume Illumination's mark with a basic attack. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding for poke; save it to stop Aurora's engage or when you have a chance to kill her.
Aurora.phase: Mid to late game, once you have built up ability power, is when Lux's burst is strong; later on, prioritize positioning over damage.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and that damage increases the more health the target has lost. If you're cursed, move off the line connecting you and Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before the curse is recalled. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, place Lux E Lucent Singularity where she might emerge and wait until she reappears. Also watch for whether you can retreat before Aurora R Between Worlds forms.

Blitzcrank.laning: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls only the first target it hits, so don't stand beside minions; always stand behind them. Watch Blitzcrank's mana bar, and after his grab misses, gain an advantage by pushing the lane or trading. If you're playing support Lux and need to pull the wave, don't hit minions with Lux E Lucent Singularity; hit only the enemy champion.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill if she lands Lux Q Light Binding, but she has no ability to escape if caught by Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, so managing your distance comes first. Later in the game, positioning matters more than damage, so fight behind your frontline.
Blitzcrank.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. The main damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Blitzcrank.combo: When you have a chance to kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier may activate, so secure a finishing tool before using this combo to finish him.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is Lux's chance to move forward. If you land Lux Q Light Binding then, Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so you can keep attacking.
Blitzcrank.fight: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, move forward, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, and trade damage with a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding for routine poke; use it to stop Blitzcrank's engage or when you have a chance to kill him. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so keep attacking when you have an engage angle where you can land the root.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Blitzcrank's initiation with Lux Q Light Binding, and block his engage path with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies, while keeping in mind that Blitzcrank R Static Field breaks shields. Use Lux R Final Spark to pierce clustered enemies in a line or when you can secure a definite finish.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field can easily follow, so when Q is available, keep your distance behind minions. Without vision in brush, it's hard to read the grab's path, so stay well away from brush and check it with Lux E Lucent Singularity before entering. Blitzcrank R Static Field breaks shields, so don't rely on Lux W Prismatic Barrier and stand within grab range.

Hwei.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop engages and Lux E Lucent Singularity to block paths. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. Don’t lead an engage while Hwei E Subject: Torment is available, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Hwei mainly deals magic damage, and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay the detonation so you can consume the Lux P Illumination mark with both basic attacks.
Hwei.escape: The moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to engage. Hwei has no mobility, so if you hit him with Lux Q Light Binding then, he’ll struggle to escape.
Hwei.fight: To poke, place and detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding until you have a kill opportunity or need to stop Hwei’s engage. Look for a chance to catch Hwei with Lux Q Light Binding right after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been used for poke or wave clear.
Hwei.laning: Lux has no mobility and is fragile, so play at the edge of your range. Check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you see an eye left by Hwei E Subject: Torment, avoid its path or trigger it first with a minion. When pulling the wave, don’t overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions, and don’t cast it on cooldown or you’ll run out of mana.
Hwei.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power. In the late game, positioning matters more than damage, so fight from behind your frontline.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by a root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you may take a rapid follow-up of damage, making it especially dangerous. If the first ability hits, reposition immediately to dodge the second. Don’t walk through paths covered by Hwei Q Subject: Disaster’s area effect; take a wide detour.

Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and keep poking with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When pulling the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity so you don’t push the wave unnecessarily. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision before approaching.
Lulu.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and hold it → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Lulu.escape: After Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth are down is your chance to close the distance and engage. If Lux Q Light Binding lands then, Lulu has no skill to create distance on her own and will have a hard time escaping.
Lulu.fight: Usually, keep poking from maximum range with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop an engage. When Lulu E Help, Pix! is used on an allied carry, that’s your chance to target Lulu herself. If Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth are down and Lux Q Light Binding lands, follow up with a kill combo.
Lulu.phase: Lux can look for a kill from early on if Lux Q Light Binding lands, but managing your distance comes first. In the late game, positioning matters more than damage, so stay behind your team’s frontline.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block routes with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect your allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, look at Lulu herself or another target instead of focusing damage on the protected target. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.
Lulu.watch: If Lux is slowed by Lulu Q Glitterlance and silenced by Lulu W Whimsy, she has trouble avoiding the follow-up attacks because she has no mobility abilities. Lulu R Wild Growth knocks up nearby enemies and immediately increases its target’s health, so while it’s available, don’t get close or unload a kill combo on a protected target.

Morgana.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Morgana's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block entry paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don't waste Q on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Morgana.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Morgana's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If healing becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon next to reduce it.
Morgana.combo: Go in when Morgana E Black Shield is down and you have an angle to land Lux Q Light Binding. Use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate E → basic attack. Account for R's cast delay so the beam hits before the root wears off.
Morgana.escape: When Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down, you have a chance to catch her with Lux Q Light Binding. If you're in range of Morgana R Soul Shackles, you'll need to escape after it tethers you, so watch your distance as you go in.
Morgana.fight: Poke by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding to counter Morgana Q Dark Binding and for kill opportunities. Don't use your binding on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Stay at the edge of your range, with the wave positioned so minions block Morgana Q Dark Binding. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and don't cast E every time it's off cooldown so you don't run out of mana. When you need to pull the wave, keep E from hitting minions.
Morgana.phase: Early on, Lux can create a kill opportunity by landing her Q root, but dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding comes first. In the late game, Lux's positioning matters, so stay behind your frontline.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will follow, so dodge with minions between you. When your health is low, don't walk through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles tethers you, get out of range before the stun triggers.

Neeko.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes where you have no vision first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If someone approaches alone unexpectedly after Neeko disappears from view, suspect a disguise and back away. When pulling the wave, don't overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions; use it on the wave only when you need to push.
Neeko.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Neeko's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block entry paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Stand apart from allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can't catch several of you. If you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom or a disguised enemy closes in, leave the area. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don't stand on top of an ally. A disguised Neeko may hide the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so back away early if a suspicious target approaches. Don't chase Neeko W Shapesplitter's clone; watch the real Neeko's position.
Neeko.build: Build survivability early with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Neeko's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can lead into Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: When you can reliably root Neeko, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity so two basic attacks consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Neeko.escape: Go in while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down. Hit Lux Q Light Binding then, and deal damage while keeping your distance. Don't change your approach to chase Neeko W Shapesplitter's clone.
Neeko.fight: To poke, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding until you need to stop Neeko's engage or secure a kill. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, keep your distance and look for a chance to counter with Lux Q Light Binding.
Neeko.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill with Lux Q Light Binding, but first keep enough distance to dodge Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. In the mid to late game, Lux's burst becomes strong as her ability power builds, but the later the game goes, the more important it is to stay out of reach.

Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so don't give her an advantage in the early or mid game and build armor. Lux's damage becomes strong later, but Qiyana can get on top of you, so prioritize positioning, stay with allies, and stand away from terrain.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Qiyana's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage. Stand away from walls and terrain so multiple allies aren't caught by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce multiple enemies or secure a kill.
Qiyana.watch: When Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal has the river element, it can lead into a root, so retreat out of range as soon as she approaches. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can stun and deal heavy damage when it hits terrain, so don't stand with your back to a wall and avoid riversides and narrow passages. If Qiyana disappears while holding the brush element, move into allied vision to prepare for an ambush.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana's main damage is physical and Lux has low armor, so survive with Cloth Armor, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Since there is a high risk of being caught by Qiyana, an assassin, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Qiyana.combo: For a kill when Qiyana's mobility is down, start with Lux Q Light Binding, then place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Follow with Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don't chase her. Let Qiyana's engage combo pass, then counterattack with Lux Q Light Binding once both mobility abilities are down, especially before Qiyana E Audacity is back up.
Qiyana.fight: Lux has no mobility, so wait for Qiyana's engage at the edge of your range and save Lux Q Light Binding to stop it. If both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are down and she remains in front of you, bind her with Lux Q Light Binding and counterattack. In particular, look for a chance before Qiyana E Audacity is back up.
Qiyana.laning: Poke by placing and detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to interrupt Qiyana's engage or set up a kill. Check brush you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and don't cast E every time it's up or you'll run out of mana.

Renata.laning: Lux has no mobility and is vulnerable to ambushes, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes without vision first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with E so hitting minions doesn't push the wave. Pressure Renata Glasc herself, but don't waste Q and lose your way to counterattack.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target hit and throws them, potentially stunning allies too, so dodge from behind minions or your frontline. If hit by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, you'll briefly lose control and attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from allies while her R is available. Right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so that enemy can't fully revive through a takedown.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility of her own, so she'll have trouble escaping if you hit her with Lux Q Light Binding when you can close the distance. After Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, the risk of her counterattacking with a root and throw is lower, so look for a chance to engage. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, don't go in while grouped with allies.
Renata.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Renata Glasc's damage is mainly magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy's healing becomes a problem, choose Morellonomicon.
Renata.combo: When you have a chance to catch Renata Glasc, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and leave it in place → Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate E → attack. Don't detonate E right away, so you can consume Lux P Illumination's mark with two attacks. Account for R's cast delay so it hits before Q's root ends.
Renata.fight: Usually, hit with Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then poke with an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to catch Renata Glasc or stop an engage. Renata Glasc has no mobility of her own, so bind her with Lux Q Light Binding when you get a chance to close the distance.
Renata.phase: Later, Lux is vulnerable to enemies who get on top of her, so prioritize positioning over damage.
Renata.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. When Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, engage while keeping your distance from allies. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce grouped enemies or secure a kill.

Sona.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Don't stand in a line with your allies where Sona R Crescendo can hit you all. Disrupt her positioning so Sona gets separated from her group, and use Lux R Final Spark when enemies overlap in a line.
Sona.phase: Early on, Lux can apply pressure before Sona builds up Power Chord’s scaling stacks. However, Sona gets stronger over time, so avoid extended fights later and protect Lux’s position.
Sona.build: Sona's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If the healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon.
Sona.combo: When you have a chance to kill Sona, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate E → basic attack.
Sona.escape: Look for an opening after Sona R Crescendo is down or after you dodge the stun angle she created by moving forward. Land Lux Q Light Binding before Sona can use Sona E Song of Celerity to create distance and escape.
Sona.fight: Poke Sona with Lux E Lucent Singularity when she steps forward to activate her aura, then use a basic attack after it detonates to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Sona can escape with Sona E Song of Celerity, so when going for a kill, land Lux Q Light Binding first instead of relying on a slow.
Sona.laning: Keep forcing trades early, when Sona is weak and her abilities cost a lot of mana. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop an engage instead of using it to poke. When pulling the lane, don't overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions; check bushes you have no vision of with E.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns all allies standing in a line, so spread out to either side when Sona steps forward. If Sona prepares an empowered basic attack and enters range, keep your distance to avoid the bonus damage or slow from Sona P Power Chord.

Taric.laning: Play at the edge of your range, and check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it for routine poke; hold it to stop Taric from engaging or to set up a kill. When pulling the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Only overlap it with the minion wave when you want to push.
Taric.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. When the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance activates, root affected enemies with Lux Q Light Binding and wait out its duration, then deal damage again as soon as it ends. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies without damage immunity in a line or to secure a clear takedown.
Taric.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Taric deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. If the healing from Taric Q Starlight's Touch becomes a problem, choose Morellonomicon.
Taric.combo: If Taric E Dazzle is down and you have a kill opportunity, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. If the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance is active, stop dealing damage and use the combo after it ends.
Taric.escape: After dodging Taric E Dazzle to the side and its stun is down, that’s Lux’s chance to attack. Taric has no ability to create distance, so catch him with Lux Q Light Binding when you have an opening to engage.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity. After it detonates, use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t take close trades while Taric P Bravado empowers his basic attacks; stay far enough away that he can’t reach his target. If Taric E Dazzle is down and you have an opening to engage, catch him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Taric.phase: In the late game, prioritize finding a safe position over looking for an opening to deal damage.
Taric.watch: Dodge Taric E Dazzle by moving sideways when you see it telegraphed. Don’t unload your attacks while the damage immunity from Taric R Cosmic Radiance is active.

Viktor.phase: Early on, keep Viktor without growth stacks under pressure with poke. Viktor’s growth stacks are permanent, making him harder to deal with as time goes on, so pay special attention to your positioning in the late game.
Viktor.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive. Choose Mercury’s Treads and build magic resistance against Viktor’s magic damage.
Viktor.combo: For a kill, bind him with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Follow with Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Viktor.escape: When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, walk out of its range immediately. After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, you have a chance to close the gap and land Lux Q Light Binding. Viktor has no dash to escape on his own, so it’s hard for him to get free once rooted.
Viktor.fight: Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it for a kill opportunity or to stop Viktor from approaching. If an opportunity to close the gap comes after dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, bind him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Viktor.laning: Fight at the edge of your range, and don’t stand in the line where Viktor E Hextech Ray passes through the wave. Lux E Lucent Singularity costs a lot of mana, so don’t cast it on cooldown; use it to scout before entering a bush you have no vision of. If the color of the light on Viktor’s staff changes, he has gained an augment, so reassess trades.
Viktor.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Viktor from approaching with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can finish Viktor or hit multiple enemies in a line.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don’t stand in line with the wave; dodge sideways. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, stop trading inside it and leave immediately to avoid being stunned. Viktor Q Siphon Power grants a shield and movement speed, so be careful trading right after he uses it.

Zoe.watch: If you’re hit by Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers to get outside the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star!. Even a bubble that misses leaves a trap, so be careful around narrow paths without vision and bush entrances. When Zoe fires Zoe Q Paddle Star! and lines up its angle, interrupt her re-aiming with Lux Q Light Binding.
Zoe.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. However, you can’t reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble with resistance, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay the detonation so two basic attacks consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Lux R Final Spark takes time to fire, so time it to hit before Lux Q Light Binding wears off.
Zoe.escape: Zoe R Portal Jump always returns her to her starting point, so aim Lux Q Light Binding at that spot. The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is also an opening to engage.
Zoe.fight: Usually, hit with Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; use it to interrupt Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s re-aiming or set up a kill.
Zoe.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it’s off cooldown will drain your mana, so use it when you have a good chance to hit. If you’re playing support and need to keep the wave near your side, make sure Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t hit minions.
Zoe.phase: Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power through the mid and late game. In the late game, positioning decides fights, so avoid the angles of Zoe’s bubbles and stars by fighting at the edge of your range.
Zoe.teamfight: From behind your frontline, stop Zoe’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding and block her approach or escape route with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage. When Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for where she’ll return, and use Lux R Final Spark to pierce several enemies or secure a certain kill.

Alistar.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Alistar’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. While Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t spend your damage on Alistar; target the damage dealers behind him. If you can’t back away, you can still stop Alistar’s re-engage with Lux Q Light Binding after he activates his ultimate.
Alistar.laning: Always play at maximum range, and check brushes without vision first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you need to pull the lane, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity without touching minions. Push the lane or reposition while Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar W Headbutt are down.
Alistar.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to hold on early. Alistar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Alistar.combo: When you have a chance to kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don’t detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity immediately, so you can consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with two basic attacks.
Alistar.escape: Right after Alistar W Headbutt is down is your chance to close the gap and fight. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, bind him with Lux Q Light Binding and attack him.
Alistar.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding to interrupt Alistar W Headbutt’s engage or until you have a chance to secure a kill. Back off while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, then fight again after it ends.
Alistar.phase: Early on, Lux can find a kill after landing Lux Q Light Binding, but prioritize keeping your distance so you don’t get caught in Alistar’s combo. In the late game, focus on staying in a safe position over dealing damage.
Alistar.watch: If Alistar W Headbutt closes the gap, it can chain into the knock-up from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample. Lux has no mobility, so keep your distance at maximum range, and near a turret don’t give Alistar room to get behind you.

Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from allies to avoid the spread from Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm, and don't stand next to burning allies. Stay behind your frontline, stop initiation with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your allies. If enemies line up, use Lux R Final Spark to pierce several of them.
Brand.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Brand.combo: When you have an angle to catch Brand, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Lux R Final Spark has a delay before firing, so time it to hit before Lux Q Light Binding wears off.
Brand.escape: The moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to close the distance. If you aren't burning, Brand Q Sear can't stun you, so root Brand with Lux Q Light Binding in that state. If Brand Q Sear also misses, take the opportunity without worrying about a stun.
Brand.fight: Normally, poke by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity and then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand remains in range, look for a chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a chance to kill or to stop Brand's initiation.
Brand.laning: Don't last-hit beside burning minions, and if the wave is grouped up, step to the side. Check brush with no vision using Lux E Lucent Singularity before approaching. When you need to pull the wave, poke without letting Lux E Lucent Singularity hit minions.
Brand.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill if she lands Lux Q Light Binding, but avoid taking Brand's abilities in succession. Mid to late game, once you have built up ability power, Lux's burst is strong; later on, prioritize positioning over damage.
Brand.watch: After Brand P Blaze is applied, taking the next ability hit builds a stack, so prioritize dodging Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. While burning, move out of the projectile's path or hide behind minions to avoid the stun from Brand Q Sear. If you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast, spread out from allies.

Maokai.laning: Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision before approaching. If you keep hitting Maokai with abilities, Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing comes back sooner, so prioritize using poke abilities on the enemy damage dealers. As support, when pulling the wave, don’t let Lux E Lucent Singularity overlap with minions.
Maokai.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to counter Maokai’s magic damage. If his healing becomes a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Maokai.combo: If a kill opportunity opens after Maokai W Twisted Advance ends or is down, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Account for Lux R Final Spark’s cast delay and hit before the root wears off. Detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity late enough to fit in two basic attacks.
Maokai.escape: Right after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance is your window to engage. Catch him with Lux Q Light Binding and trade, but attack after Maokai W Twisted Advance’s dash ends.
Maokai.fight: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, fight at maximum range and save Lux Q Light Binding to stop his engage. Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, step forward to poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity and consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with a basic attack.
Maokai.phase: Early on, Lux can set up a kill with Lux Q Light Binding, but if Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, managing your distance comes first. In the late game, it’s important to position so you can’t be caught rather than prioritize damage.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop Maokai’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block the approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Fight in open terrain where you have room to sidestep Maokai R Nature's Grasp. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, so keep your distance while it’s available, and don’t use basic attacks or abilities during the dash. Avoid bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has placed a sapling. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, move perpendicular to its direction.

Naafiri.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Naafiri's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies to absorb damage. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, don't get isolated, and back off immediately after an ally dies to avoid her chain dashes.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Lux has low armor, so build Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Since Naafiri is an assassin, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too. If healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Naafiri.combo: For a kill opportunity, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Avoid starting the combo during the brief period when Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active.
Naafiri.escape: The window for Lux to go in is before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back up. Don't engage just because either Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers or Naafiri E Eviscerate is down; check her remaining mobility abilities before rooting her with Lux Q Light Binding.
Naafiri.fight: Poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity at the edge of your range, and place it along Naafiri's approach to use its slow. Save Lux Q Light Binding to interrupt Naafiri's dash or secure a clear kill opportunity; don't use it to poke.
Naafiri.laning: Naafiri is melee, so farm and poke from behind your minion line, and don't give her an angle to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. Detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark, but don't cast E every time it's off cooldown or you'll run out of mana. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity before entering.
Naafiri.phase: Naafiri is most dangerous during the mid-game roaming phase, so keep vision wide and don't travel alone. In the late game, group up to block Naafiri's approach, and prioritize Lux's positioning over damage.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, back away until it ends to avoid taking the second dagger. Naafiri E Eviscerate and R Hounds' Pursuit are dashes, so don't give her an engage angle and save Lux Q Light Binding to stop her engage. Naafiri W The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable for a short time, so attack after it ends.

Soraka.laning: Pressure the enemy marksman and make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion; this costs Soraka health. To keep up that pressure, dodge Soraka Q Starcall. When pulling the lane, don't overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions; overlap it with the wave only when you need to push.
Soraka.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Soraka's damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance. If her healing becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Soraka.combo: When you have a chance to kill her, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Soraka.escape: Look for an opening right after Soraka E Equinox is used for poke or waveclear. If you land Lux Q Light Binding before stepping into the zone, you can keep Soraka, who has no mobility spell, rooted in place.
Soraka.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. If Soraka E Equinox is down, root her with Lux Q Light Binding and deal your damage in a short burst. Soraka R Wish provides healing, so don't spread your finishing damage out over time.
Soraka.phase: Early on, Lux can set up a kill by landing Lux Q Light Binding. In the late game, positioning is important, so fight at the edge of your range from behind your frontline.
Soraka.teamfight: When you have an opening against Soraka, target Soraka herself instead of continuing to hit an ally she's healing. Stay behind your frontline, interrupt engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can finish an enemy for sure or hit several enemies lined up together.
Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows you, heals Soraka, and increases her movement speed, so you need to dodge it to keep up the pressure. Inside Soraka E Equinox's zone, you are silenced and can also be rooted, so dodge it before stepping into the zone.

Vladimir.teamfight: From behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. If several allies are hit together by Vladimir R Hemoplague, its healing is greater, so don’t group inside its area. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit grouped enemies in a line or to secure a certain kill.
Vladimir.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads. Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Vladimir.combo: First, poke Vladimir to draw out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, then hit him with Lux Q Light Binding after it ends. While Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed, follow with Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. Vladimir’s movement speed is reduced while he charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so you can also keep a minion between you as you close the distance. Vladimir has no ability to create distance on his own, so keep attacking after landing your root.
Vladimir.fight: Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to catch Vladimir after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends. Vladimir’s movement speed is reduced while he charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, giving you a chance to manage your distance.
Vladimir.laning: Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it’s off cooldown will drain your mana, so use it when you have a good chance to hit. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity and play at the edge of your range.
Vladimir.phase: In the late game, Lux’s positioning is important, so fight from behind your frontline.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool removes incoming projectiles, so don’t throw Lux Q Light Binding first. When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charging, keep minions between you or move out of range. If you’re hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so step back and fight after the effect ends.

Ahri.combo: Dodge Ahri E Charm, then land Lux Q Light Binding when Ahri R Spirit Rush is down. Place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it immediately, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Ahri.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to hold on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. However, magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm has just missed too, it’s a good time to start a fight while dodging her counterattack.
Ahri.fight: Usually, poke by hitting and detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Ahri.laning: Move behind minions to dodge Ahri E Charm, and fight at maximum range since Lux has no mobility. Before entering a brush you have no vision of, check it with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you need to pull the lane as a support, use Lux E Lucent Singularity without overlapping it with minions.
Ahri.phase: Early on, dodge Ahri E Charm with a minion between you and Ahri, and poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity and basic attacks. In the late game, positioning matters more than damage, so fight behind your frontline.
Ahri.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to shield them from damage. Look for an opening right after Ahri E Charm is down, but use Lux R Final Spark for a sure finish or when you can hit multiple enemies in a line.
Ahri.watch: If you get hit by Ahri E Charm, you can take her entire follow-up combo, so dodge it with a minion wave between you and Ahri. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit you on the return as well, so move outside its return path even after dodging the first pass. While Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, watch for her dashes and don’t use Lux Q Light Binding carelessly.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the wind-up for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and walk out of its range. It’s best to dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam; if it’s hard to dodge, avoid the blade’s edge and move close to her. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a line and is unstoppable, so don’t line up with your backline.
Ambessa.laning: Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to place it along the enemy’s approach path or check a brush without vision. Don’t cast it whenever it’s off cooldown, so you don’t run out of mana; when you need to pull the lane, avoid the minions and hit only Ambessa.
Ambessa.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Ambessa’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Ambessa R Public Execution is unstoppable, so don’t try to interrupt it with Lux Q Light Binding; don’t line up with your backline even while facing off. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.
Ambessa.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa’s damage is mostly physical, so build armor first. If the enemy team has an assassin, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier; if the healing from Ambessa R Public Execution is a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Ambessa.combo: When Ambessa’s abilities and charges are spent and you have an angle to land Lux Q Light Binding, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don’t detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity immediately, so you can consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with two basic attacks.
Ambessa.escape: Go in right after Ambessa has spent her ability-chained dashes and the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate, along with her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges. Then catch her with Lux Q Light Binding and deal damage. If you see the wind-up for Ambessa W Repudiation, don’t attack; move out of its range.
Ambessa.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding to stop Ambessa’s engage or until you have a chance to secure a kill. Counterattack right after Ambessa has spent her abilities and her Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges.

Azir.laning: Play at max range and use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check brush with no vision. If you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity; overlap the wave only when you need to push.
Azir.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Don't group up as you enter a narrow passage where Azir R Emperor's Divide can push you together. Use Lux R Final Spark when enemies line up or you can secure a definite finish.
Azir.build: Early on, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Azir deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.combo: After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, root him with Lux Q Light Binding and cast Lux R Final Spark while Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed. Then use a basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is down is your window to close the distance. If you land Lux Q Light Binding then, Azir can't use that dash to escape, so find an angle that avoids the straight line where his soldier is standing. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is available, don't have several of you enter a narrow passage together.
Azir.fight: While Azir's soldiers are stationary and Azir Q Conquering Sands is unavailable, angle around a soldier to target Azir himself. Normally, trade briefly by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity and then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding for poke; save it to catch Azir after Azir E Shifting Sands is down or to stop his engage.
Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so trade in short bursts, and prioritize Lux's positioning later in the game.
Azir.watch: Azir Q Conquering Sands slows you, and you can keep taking damage where soldiers summoned by Azir W Arise! are standing, so move off the straight line in front of a soldier. Azir E Shifting Sands is a dash that grants a shield, so stop his engage with Lux Q Light Binding when he approaches. In narrow passages, several of you can be pushed together by Azir R Emperor's Divide, so don't group up as you enter.

Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid Braum Q Winter's Bite, but avoid moments when there's a gap between minions and you're directly in line with Braum. Lux has no mobility, so play at max range, and use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check brush with no vision first. If you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity; overlap the minion wave only when you need to push.
Braum.build: Early on, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots to prepare for the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. Braum's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Braum.combo: Start the combo when Braum E Unbreakable is down and you have an angle to land Lux Q Light Binding. Use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is your window to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding and engage. If Braum E Unbreakable is also down, you can find an angle without worrying about your frontal projectile being blocked. Keep your distance first if you're in a position to get caught by Braum Q Winter's Bite or Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.fight: Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is your chance to close the distance and catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. If Braum E Unbreakable is up, wait until his shield drops or you have an angle from the side. Normally, poke by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity and then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark; save Lux Q Light Binding to stop initiation or for a chance to kill.
Braum.phase: Early on, Lux can create a chance to kill by landing Lux Q Light Binding, but once Braum catches you, his follow-up can be hard to avoid, so managing your distance comes first. Later in the game, a safe position matters more than damage, so don't stand in the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. If Braum E Unbreakable blocks the front, wait for his shield to drop or find an angle from the side. Target the person Braum is protecting instead of focusing him, and if enemies line up, hit several with Lux R Final Spark.
Braum.watch: Dodge Braum Q Winter's Bite from behind minions, and if Braum P Concussive Blows marks you, get out of range before the stun triggers. Don't throw projectiles toward the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces; wait until his shield drops or you have an angle from the side. If you see Braum R Glacial Fissure's cast animation, move sideways out of its line and avoid the lingering slow zone too.

Leona.laning: Don’t trade with basic attacks against Leona’s high early defenses; chip away at her health with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Lux has no mobility, so stay at maximum range. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision. When you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity so you don’t push the wave by hitting minions.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with an ally. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so watch the distance she can cover rather than whether she has cast a skill. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Leona.combo: Hit Leona with Lux Q Light Binding during the window when Leona E Zenith Blade is down and she can’t engage. If you have a kill opportunity, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away, then follow with Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Leona.escape: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your window to close the distance and attack. If Lux gets caught in the crowd control that follows from Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare, she has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance beforehand and save Lux Q Light Binding to stop her engage.
Leona.fight: Poke from maximum range with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with a basic attack when it’s safe to get in range. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Leona’s engage or set up a kill. Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, catch her with Lux Q Light Binding and counterattack.
Leona.phase: Early on, account for Leona’s high defenses by poking with Lux’s range and magic damage, and look for a kill when Lux Q Light Binding lands. In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst gets stronger as she builds ability power, but in the late game, positioning so you can’t be caught matters more.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop Leona’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block the approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block incoming damage. If Leona P Sunlight’s mark is on you, back away immediately. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce several enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.

Milio.fight: To poke, hit Milio with Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop the enemy from engaging. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, look for a chance to root Milio with Lux Q Light Binding and focus your damage on him.
Milio.laning: Early on, use trades to drain mana and take wave control so the Milio composition can't buy time. Lux E Lucent Singularity costs a lot of mana, so don't cast it every time it's off cooldown. When pulling the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity; overlap it with the wave only when you need to push. Check bushes without vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity before entering.
Milio.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Milio has no mobility and low defensive stats, so after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, you can target Milio before the enemy marksman. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill. If healing is a problem, use Lux E Lucent Singularity and Lux R Final Spark with Morellonomicon to reduce healing on multiple enemies.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows the first enemy it hits, so don't get close to Milio while this ability is available. When Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy marksman's range, delay frontline fights and wait out its duration. Keep in mind that Milio E Warm Hugs grants a shield and increased movement speed, while Milio R Breath of Life heals and grants tenacity.
Milio.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Milio deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team's healing becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Milio.combo: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and you have a kill opportunity, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delaying the detonation lets you consume Lux P Illumination's mark with two basic attacks. Lux R Final Spark has a cast time, so time the delay to hit before Lux Q Light Binding wears off.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only escape tool and knocks back the first enemy it hits, so the window after it's down is your chance to target him. Root Milio then with Lux Q Light Binding. If Lux Q Light Binding misses, Lux is left exposed, so use it only when you have a clear angle.
Milio.phase: In the mid to late game, Lux's burst becomes strong as her ability power builds, but the Milio composition also gets stronger over time. In the late game, prioritize Lux's positioning over damage.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison falls slowly, but stuns if it hits, so sidestep when you see it coming. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it too; follow-up attacks are dangerous if it hits. Don't fight head-on with an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; keep your distance until it expires.
Nami.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Nami deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Nami.combo: When Nami Q Aqua Prison misses and you have an angle to land Lux Q Light Binding, start the kill combo. Use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Nami.escape: Go in right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep it first, and wait until Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing expires before fighting an affected enemy. If you've closed the distance to Nami, catch her with Lux Q Light Binding.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is a good chance to target Nami. She has low health and no mobility, so secure vision, find an angle on her, and root her with Lux Q Light Binding. Normally, poke by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding for kill opportunities or to stop engages.
Nami.laning: Lux has no mobility, so manage your distance at the edge of your range, and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity before approaching. When you need to pull the wave, hit only Nami with Lux E Lucent Singularity so you don't hit minions. Don't cast Lux E Lucent Singularity every time it's off cooldown or you'll run out of mana.
Nami.phase: In the late game, prioritize Lux's positioning over damage so she doesn't get caught.
Nami.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Keep your distance to avoid the combo of Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to secure a kill or when you have an angle to hit several enemies in a line.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits you, move away from allies before the root spreads. After Senna hits you once, back off to avoid taking a second attack and deny her soul collection.
Senna.build: Senna's main damage is physical, and Lux has low armor, so build armor first. Early on, buy Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Senna.combo: When you have a chance to kill her, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don't detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away so you can consume Lux P Illumination's mark with a basic attack.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace is down, look for a chance to close the distance and land Lux Q Light Binding. Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed when active, so back off instead of fighting her there and move to an area where you have vision.
Senna.fight: Poke Senna with Lux E Lucent Singularity when she steps forward to collect a soul, then use a basic attack after it detonates to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it for simple poke; hold it for a kill opportunity or to stop Senna from approaching. When Senna W Last Embrace is down, you have less reason to worry about being rooted, so look for a chance to close the distance.
Senna.laning: Watch where souls appear and poke Senna when she steps out to collect them to hinder her growth. Play at the edge of your range, and check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you need to pull the lane, hit only Senna with Lux E Lucent Singularity; overlap it with minions only when you want to push.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so pressure her when she steps out to collect a soul. If left alone, her attack damage and range will grow, so disrupt her soul collection from the start to keep her from scaling into the late game.
Senna.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to secure vision or place Lux E Lucent Singularity in the mist to block an entry path. When enemies line up, look for an angle with Lux R Final Spark that pierces multiple targets.

Swain.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, don't keep fighting nearby; move out of range and wait for it to end. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit grouped enemies in a line or finish them off for sure.
Swain.phase: Swain is weakest early, before he has stacks, so pressure him then to stop his growth. However, Swain gains health over time, so later protect Lux’s position and apply Grievous Wounds to his healing.
Swain.build: Swain's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Swain's healing becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Swain.combo: After Swain E Nevermove is down, land Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don't detonate it right away; use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Swain.escape: Dodge the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove and engage right after the ability is down. Swain has no way to create distance, so if you land Lux Q Light Binding then, he won't be able to get away.
Swain.fight: Poke near the edge of your maximum range by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; use it for a kill opportunity or to stop an engage after Swain E Nevermove is down.
Swain.laning: Take control of the lane early, before Swain builds stacks. Keep your distance to reduce the damage from Swain Q Death's Hand, and dodge the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove as well. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and when pulling the lane, keep this ability off the minions.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove also roots on its return, so stay out of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with multiple bolts that overlap at close range, so keep your distance. When Swain activates Swain R Demonic Ascension, move out of range and wait for it to end.

Thresh.escape: Right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the gap. If Thresh W Dark Passage is also down and hasn’t come off cooldown yet, hit him with Lux Q Light Binding to stop his engage. Avoid the line between Thresh and his ally so Thresh E Flay can’t pull you in.
Thresh.laning: Move side to side at the edge of your range, and check bushes without vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When Thresh steps forward to collect souls, trade with Lux E Lucent Singularity and a basic attack. When you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity so the wave doesn’t push.
Thresh.watch: If Thresh Q Death Sentence hits you, Thresh can dash in and pull you with Thresh E Flay, so move sideways when you see him raise his hook. Be especially careful to change direction again when stepping up to last-hit, and don’t stand on the line between Thresh and his ally.
Thresh.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Thresh's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance. Since Lux has no mobility and can easily take follow-up hits after being caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay, prioritize tenacity.
Thresh.combo: If Thresh Q Death Sentence is down and Thresh W Dark Passage hasn’t returned yet, bind him with Lux Q Light Binding. Then place Lux E Lucent Singularity and, while it remains active, use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Thresh.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Thresh from engaging or to set up a kill. Close the gap and fight right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, especially when Thresh W Dark Passage is also down.
Thresh.phase: Early on, Lux Q Light Binding can set up a kill, but Lux has no mobility, so dodge Thresh’s abilities that can catch her first. Thresh gets tankier as he collects souls, so poke him when he steps forward to collect one. In the late game, prioritize your positioning.
Thresh.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Thresh from engaging with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or to secure a clear takedown. When Thresh W Dark Passage appears, immediately finish off the target or back away. If Thresh R The Box traps you, quickly decide with your allies which direction to break through.

Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he builds items, so don’t let him farm freely. Lux’s burst also becomes strong in the mid-to-late game, but in the late game, prioritize positioning and watch for enemies closing in.
Corki.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game and buy Plated Steelcaps. Corki’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. However, resistance cannot block the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, and Corki E Gatling Gun shreds resistances, so getting out of its range takes priority.
Corki.combo: Hit Corki with Lux Q Light Binding after Corki W Valkyrie is down. Place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Corki.escape: Right after forcing Corki to use Corki W Valkyrie is your chance to close the distance. If you hit him with Lux Q Light Binding then, he can’t escape with his mobility spell.
Corki.fight: Hit Corki with Lux E Lucent Singularity at the edge of its range, detonate it, then trade with an attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to catch Corki when Corki W Valkyrie is down and set up a kill.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki during the first five levels, when his base stats are low, and disrupt his farming. Lux has no mobility, so stay at the edge of your range. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you’re playing support and need to pull the wave, don’t overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with the minions.
Corki.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Corki’s engage and Lux E Lucent Singularity to block paths. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your allies as they respond to Corki’s area damage. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or to secure a kill.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage damages targets around the first one it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range instead. Reposition to avoid being hit repeatedly, especially by the third missile. Corki E Gatling Gun shreds your armor and magic resistance, so step to the side instead of standing in front of it.

Nautilus.laning: Play at the edge of your range, and check bushes without vision first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Keep minions between you and Nautilus Q Dredge Line, but when you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Nautilus's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block entry paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill. Don't stand with allies in the path of Nautilus R Depth Charge.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is key to his engage and kill opportunities, so dodge it with minions between you. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots with his first basic attack too, so don't stay within his basic attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in its path with your allies.
Nautilus.escape: This is your opening right after you make Nautilus use Nautilus Q Dredge Line. When Nautilus Q Dredge Line, his mobility tool, is down, root him with Lux Q Light Binding. After the trade, create distance so you don’t get hit by Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s empowered attack.
Nautilus.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Nautilus deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.combo: After Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, if Lux Q Light Binding hits, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then consume Lux P Illumination's mark in this order: Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Nautilus.fight: If Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, keep your distance and trade. Normally, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Nautilus from engaging or to secure a kill opportunity.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, Lux can create a kill opportunity by landing Lux Q Light Binding, but distance management comes first because Nautilus can easily follow up once he catches you. In the mid to late game, Lux's burst becomes strong as her ability power builds, and positioning is important in the late game.

Pyke.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes without vision first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Maintaining vision as Pyke retreats can prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones. If you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity without overlapping minions.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Pyke's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block his approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a kill. Avoid standing next to a low-health ally so you don't both get hit by the X-shaped area of Pyke R Death From Below and trigger chained executes.
Pyke.watch: Pyke E Phantom Undertow leaves a stun along his dash path, so dodge to the side of the direction he traveled. If you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive beneath your feet, you're already in range, so retreat toward an ally or turret. Keep your distance so you aren't hit in succession after being pulled by Pyke Q Bone Skewer, and watch out for Pyke R Death From Below when your health is low.
