Pyke.build: Pyke's damage is mainly physical and Lux has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Pyke has many ways to catch you, so build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too. Account for Pyke's penetration and execute threshold by considering your total health as well as adding some armor.
Pyke.combo: When you have a chance to catch Pyke, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and leave it in place → Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack. Don't detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away, so you can consume Lux P Illumination's mark with two attacks.
Pyke.escape: Don't engage immediately just because you dodged Pyke E Phantom Undertow. Pyke will have trouble getting away if you hit him with Lux Q Light Binding during the window before Pyke R Death From Below is back up.
Pyke.fight: For a short trade, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; hold it to interrupt Pyke's engage or set up a kill. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, look for a chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding if Pyke R Death From Below is also still down.
Pyke.phase: Lux can set up a kill early by hitting Pyke with Lux Q Light Binding, but distance management comes first because Pyke can chain attacks after catching you once. Later, prioritize positioning over damage because Pyke can target fragile allies.

Rakan.laning: Play at the edge of Lux's range, and check bushes where you have no vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity before entering. When you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity so the wave doesn't get pushed. Lux E Lucent Singularity costs a lot of mana, so don't cast it every time it's up.
Rakan.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Rakan's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block his approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don't stand in a line so multiple allies aren't hit by Rakan R The Quickness, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce grouped enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Rakan.build: Rakan's damage is mainly magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If the enemy's healing becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Rakan.combo: When you have a kill opportunity because Rakan W Grand Entrance is down or you have hit him with Lux Q Light Binding, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and leave it in place → Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack. Delay the detonation of Lux E Lucent Singularity so you can consume Lux P Illumination's mark with two attacks.
Rakan.escape: The window for Lux to close the distance and fight is right after making Rakan use Rakan W Grand Entrance and dodging it. Hit him with Lux Q Light Binding then to catch him. Rakan E Battle Dance can only be used on allied champions, so also look for a moment when Rakan moves alone, away from his allies.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is stripped away. Usually, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark, and save Lux Q Light Binding to interrupt Rakan's engage or set up a kill. Right after dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, you have a chance to bind and attack him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Rakan.phase: Later, positioning matters more than damage, so watch Rakan's engage path and stay behind your frontline.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance's landing point is visible in advance, so dodge the knock-up by stepping aside when Rakan starts moving. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so hit him with Lux Q Light Binding before he touches you or put terrain between you. Lux has no mobility and is easy to hit with follow-up attacks once caught, so keep your distance first.

Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is standing alone, away from her allies, or when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Usually, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; use it when you have a chance to catch her or need to stop an engage.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Spread out so Seraphine R Encore can't gain range by passing through your allies. Use Lux R Final Spark when enemies are lined up or you can finish them off for sure.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine and use Lux W Prismatic Barrier to shield against the follow-up damage. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it passes through one of your allied champions, so don't stand in a line with your allies.
Seraphine.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Seraphine's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Seraphine.combo: When you have a chance to kill Seraphine, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don't detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away so you can consume Lux P Illumination's mark with two basic attacks.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses is your chance to close the distance. Seraphine has no mobility spell, so if you land Lux Q Light Binding then, she will have a hard time getting away. Conversely, if Lux Q Light Binding misses, Lux is left exposed, so don't chase recklessly.
Seraphine.laning: Lux has no mobility spell, so play at the edge of your range, and check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it comes off cooldown will drain your mana, so choose a good angle to land it. If you're playing support, when pulling the lane, hit only Seraphine and avoid the minions; overlap it with the wave only when you need to push.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, Lux can set up a kill by landing Lux Q Light Binding. In the late game, positioning matters more than damage, so keep your distance to avoid Seraphine's crowd control.

Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-peel, so the moment after she uses it is your opening. Lux has no mobility spell, so avoid the line of her spheres as you close the distance, then catch her with Lux Q Light Binding.
Syndra.laning: Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are non-targeted abilities you can dodge on foot, so get boots early and don't stand in line with her spheres. Lux has no mobility spell, so play at the edge of your range, and check bushes where you have no vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it comes off cooldown will drain your mana, so choose a good angle to land it.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere lands between Lux and Syndra, Syndra can push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun you, so move out of its line. Syndra W Force of Will slows and deals true damage, so magic resistance alone won't let you withstand it. When several spheres are on the ground, beware the damage and execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power, and reposition.
Syndra.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Syndra's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Also watch your total health to prepare for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down and you've landed Lux Q Light Binding, use Lux R Final Spark while Lux E Lucent Singularity is still active. Then use a basic attack, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, and use another basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Syndra.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; hold it for a kill opportunity or to stop Syndra from engaging.
Syndra.phase: Early on, Lux can set up a kill by landing Lux Q Light Binding, but she's fragile and has no mobility spell, so she needs to fight at the edge of her range. In the late game, prioritize positioning over damage, and adjust your distance to account for the increased power or range when Syndra's ability effects change.
Syndra.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Syndra's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. When enemies line up, use Lux R Final Spark to pierce several targets or finish them off for sure.

Zed.phase: Zed peaks in the mid game, so don’t give him an early lead and group with your allies to reduce the chances of anyone getting caught alone. Lux’s burst grows strong as she builds ability power through the mid and late game, but in the late game, prioritize positioning so Zed can’t get on you.
Zed.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Zed’s main damage is physical and Lux has low armor, so build armor early. Since Zed is an assassin, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier too.
Zed.combo: For a kill, root Zed with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark.
Zed.escape: Look to engage after Zed W Living Shadow is used, once the shadow disappears or Zed has already switched positions. If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can escape with Zed R Death Mark, so especially look for an opening before Zed R Death Mark is ready again. If you land Lux Q Light Binding then, Zed won’t be able to escape.
Zed.fight: For short trades, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Zed’s engage or set up a kill. Your chance to attack comes right after Zed W Living Shadow is used, once the shadow disappears or Zed has already switched positions.
Zed.laning: You have no mobility and low armor, so play at the edge of your range and first check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it’s off cooldown will drain your mana, so use it when you have a good chance to hit. If you need to keep the wave near your side, don’t overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions.
Zed.teamfight: From behind your frontline, stop Zed’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding and block his approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. While Zed R Death Mark is active on a target, using Lux Q Light Binding on Zed can reduce the time he has to build damage. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or secure a certain kill.
Zed.watch: Watch where Zed W Living Shadow places his shadow, and move outside the slow area of Zed E Shadow Slash cast from there. If Zed dashes in with Zed R Death Mark and applies the mark, interrupt the time he has to build damage with Lux Q Light Binding. Zed Q Razor Shuriken also deals area damage, so track both Zed and his shadow.

Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t group together with your allies. Stay behind your frontline, stop Annie’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect your allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.
Annie.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie’s damage is magic and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: When you have a chance to kill Annie, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don’t detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity immediately, so two basic attacks consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Annie.escape: If Annie has just used Annie P Pyromania’s stun, that’s your chance to go in before it’s ready again. Annie has no mobility, so if you land Lux Q Light Binding then, she’ll have a hard time escaping.
Annie.fight: While Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity from outside her range. Right after she uses the stun, look to attack with Lux Q Light Binding. Lux’s magic damage hits Annie, who has low magic resistance, hard.
Annie.laning: Poke by hitting Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Annie’s engage or find a chance to kill her. Before entering brush you have no vision of, check it with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Annie.phase: Lux can find a chance to kill from early on if she lands Lux Q Light Binding, but keep your distance while Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready. In the late game, focus on safe positioning over dealing damage.
Annie.watch: If white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, so don’t enter ability range. In particular, don’t group together where several allies could be hit by the area damage from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. After Tibbers is summoned, don’t stay in the area even if you’ve killed Annie.

Bard.laning: If Bard W Caretaker's Shrine appears in lane, walk over it to destroy it. When you need to pull the wave, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity so the wave doesn't push.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so keep your back off walls and don't line up with allies or minions. Watch for a flank through Bard E Magical Journey, and don't try to finish a target with Lux R Final Spark while Bard R Tempered Fate makes them immune to damage.
Bard.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard's damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance, and prioritize tenacity to account for the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding. If the healing from Bard W Caretaker's Shrine becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, land Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don't detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away; use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Bard.escape: Right after forcing Bard E Magical Journey is Lux's chance to close the distance. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, you have less need to worry about avoiding its stun, so catch him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Bard.fight: For poke, place and detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding for poke; use it when you have a chance to close the distance and catch Bard right after he uses Bard E Magical Journey.
Bard.phase: Mid to late game, once you have built up ability power, is the peak of Lux's burst, but positioning decides fights later on, so stay behind your frontline at max range.
Bard.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or secure a definite finish. Check whether Bard R Tempered Fate has made its targets immune to damage before choosing when to finish them.

Diana.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Diana’s engage and Lux E Lucent Singularity to block her approach. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies, but space out based on Diana’s angle of approach so several allies aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall. Use vision to prevent Diana from flanking, and cast Lux R Final Spark when enemies line up or you can secure a kill.
Diana.build: Diana mainly deals magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. If the enemy team has an assassin, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier.
Diana.combo: If you catch Diana with Lux Q Light Binding as she engages, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark, right after she uses her mobility spell is your window to counterattack. Catch her with Lux Q Light Binding and slow her with Lux E Lucent Singularity so she can’t escape. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so don’t engage; create distance instead.
Diana.fight: Fight Diana after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are down. To poke, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity and use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark, but save Lux Q Light Binding to stop Diana’s engage or set up a kill. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, create distance instead of continuing the fight.
Diana.laning: Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity before entering them.
Diana.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power. In the late game, positioning to keep Diana from closing in matters more than damage.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so dodge to the side instead of only backing away. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so move away and create distance. In team fights, spread out so several allies aren’t pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall.

Lissandra.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at maximum range, and use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision. Stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. Lux E Lucent Singularity costs a lot of mana, so don’t cast it every time it’s up.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. Watch for Lissandra E Glacial Path to be recast as it travels, and keep your distance so you don’t get caught by Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root followed by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun.
Lissandra.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and her root and stun can lock you down for follow-up hits, so build magic resistance and tenacity. If the enemy team’s healing becomes a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Lissandra.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and hold it → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is used is your chance to close the distance and catch her. If Lux Q Light Binding lands while the claw is traveling, you can stop her from recasting to teleport. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, trade right after that.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Usually, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop Lissandra E Glacial Path’s engage.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill if Lux Q Light Binding lands, but keep your distance so Lissandra can’t catch you with her engage. In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst gets stronger as she builds ability power. In the late game, prioritize positioning over damage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop Lissandra E Glacial Path’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block routes with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Decide whether to engage based on whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully spent. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.

Zilean.laning: Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it’s off cooldown will drain your mana, so choose when to use it for poke. If you need to keep the wave near your side, hit only the enemy champion with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and use this ability to check bushes without vision first.
Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and walk outside the blast radius. A target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift can’t be targeted while being revived, so don’t use abilities on them then.
Zilean.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance over armor, but tenacity makes a more immediate difference when you’re caught by the bomb stun and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp.
Zilean.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. If the target is affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, finish them after its duration ends or be ready to attack again right after they revive.
Zilean.escape: After Zilean uses the Zilean Q Time Bomb → Zilean W Rewind → Zilean Q Time Bomb combo and Zilean E Time Warp is down, you have a chance to close the distance. Zilean has no mobility, so if you land Lux Q Light Binding then, it’s difficult for him to escape. When retreating, cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier in the direction you’re running to receive the returning shield sooner.
Zilean.fight: After that, poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity and use basic attacks to consume the Lux P Illumination mark, while saving Lux Q Light Binding for a kill or to stop an engage. If you close the distance by taking advantage of Zilean’s lack of mobility, root him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Zilean.phase: Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power through the mid and late game, but in the late game, hold your position behind your frontline.
Zilean.teamfight: From behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or secure a certain kill. If it’s hard to kill a damage dealer affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, switch targets to the squishy Zilean himself.

AurelionSol.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Aurelion Sol's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Spread out so several of you aren't hit together by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. If enemies line up, find an angle for Lux R Final Spark to pierce several of them.
AurelionSol.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
AurelionSol.combo: When Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay the detonation of Lux E Lucent Singularity so two basic attacks consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after forcing Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, close the distance and look for a chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. Lux has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance if Lux Q Light Binding misses or Aurelion Sol still has an engage tool available.
AurelionSol.fight: For lane trades, place Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, root him with Lux Q Light Binding to create an opening to attack. Save Lux Q Light Binding for stopping Aurelion Sol's engage instead of using it for routine poke.
AurelionSol.laning: Pressure him from max range from the start, but don't let Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light hit you for free and build his Stardust. Lux E Lucent Singularity costs a lot of mana, so don't cast it every time it's off cooldown; also use it to check brush with no vision before entering. When you need to pull the wave, keep Lux E Lucent Singularity off the minions.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, before Aurelion Sol builds Stardust, Lux has a chance to pressure him. Lux also gains strong burst later, but watch out for Aurelion Sol's permanent scaling and empowered ultimate, and prioritize your positioning.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim if it starts hitting you. When your health is low, avoid Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can execute you, and move outward immediately if you get caught. Once he has built up Stardust, spread out from allies to avoid the knock-up and area shockwave from Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Heimerdinger.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop engages, Lux E Lucent Singularity to block paths, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don’t group in one spot in front of an objective. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Heimerdinger.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: Once you catch Heimerdinger, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay the detonation to keep consuming the Lux P Illumination mark with basic attacks, and account for Lux R Final Spark’s cast time.
Heimerdinger.escape: Approach just after a turret is placed or has fired a powerful shot, then catch Heimerdinger with Lux Q Light Binding.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t repeatedly trade head-on in front of the turrets; poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity at the edge of your range.
Heimerdinger.laning: Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Heimerdinger’s engage or set up a kill. If you’re playing support and need to pull the wave, keep Lux E Lucent Singularity off the minions, and check bushes you have no vision of first with the ability. Don’t cast Lux E Lucent Singularity on cooldown or you’ll run out of mana.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the early game, hitting Lux Q Light Binding can set up a kill, but Lux has no mobility, so keep your distance. In the mid-to-late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power, and positioning matters more than damage as the game goes on.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing marker, move to the side to avoid the center. If you’re hit, leave the range of the fully charged turret.

Rell.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Rell's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and place Lux E Lucent Singularity along her approach. After Rell Q Shattering Strike has passed, cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Before a teamfight starts, spread out from allies so multiple people aren't pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm, and use Lux R Final Spark to pierce grouped enemies.
Rell.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Rell's damage is mainly magic and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity is also important because Lux has no mobility and is vulnerable to follow-up hits after Rell's crowd control.
Rell.combo: When Rell's engage is down and you can safely attack, bind her with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity. Don't detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity right away; use Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Rell.escape: If only Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down, she can escape with Rell E Full Tilt, so don't go in deep. Look for a chance to attack with Lux Q Light Binding after Rell's mobility is down, especially before Rell E Full Tilt is back up.
Rell.fight: Poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range, then use an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to interrupt Rell's engage or set up a kill. Right after Rell uses Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance so Rell is left alone.
Rell.laning: Rell has low magic resistance early and cannot restore health in lane, so chip away at her with Lux E Lucent Singularity from outside her engage range. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity every time it's up will drain your mana, so choose an angle where it will hit. If you're playing support and need to pull the wave, don't let Lux E Lucent Singularity hit minions, and check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Rell.phase: Early, Lux can poke from range by taking advantage of Rell's low magic resistance and lack of healing. Later, positioning matters more than Lux's damage, so watch Rell's engage range and areas you have no vision of.
Rell.watch: If Rell uses Rell E Full Tilt to speed herself and one ally and runs toward you, stop trading and retreat out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down's range. If you're knocked up by Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, it can lead into the stun from Rell Q Shattering Strike and the pull from Rell R Magnet Storm. Dodge Rell Q Shattering Strike to the side; it breaks shields, so use Lux W Prismatic Barrier afterward.

Vex.laning: Lux has no mobility and is vulnerable to ambushes, so play at the edge of your range. Check bushes without vision with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and don’t cast E on cooldown or you’ll run out of mana. If you need to pull the wave, target only the enemy champion so E doesn’t hit minions.
Vex.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first; choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Vex.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate E → basic attack. Delay the E detonation to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with two basic attacks. Time R’s cast so it hits before Q’s root ends.
Vex.escape: If both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and Vex W Personal Space’s shield are down, that’s a good window to engage.
Vex.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Vex from engaging or to set up a kill. Fight when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear and Vex W Personal Space’s shield are down.
Vex.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill after landing Q’s root, but first focus on surviving Vex’s magic damage. In the late game, positioning matters more than damage, so stay behind your frontline.
Vex.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Vex from engaging with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and protect your allies with Lux W Prismatic Barrier. Have low-health allies marked by Vex R Shadow Surge move out of Vex’s range first. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a clear takedown.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom’s fear is ready, watch out for Vex’s basic abilities. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so when dodging it within range, make a short sideways move. If hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, she will follow with a dash, so immediately move toward your allies and stop her engage with Lux Q Light Binding.

Sylas.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. When Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, root him with Lux Q Light Binding to create an opportunity to take him down before he heals with Sylas W Kingslayer. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to block his approach, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or to secure a certain kill.
Sylas.build: Sylas's main damage is magic, and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer becomes a problem.
Sylas.combo: When you have a chance to kill him, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Use basic attacks to consume Lux P Illumination's mark, and if the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer is a problem, apply healing reduction just before that ability lands.
Sylas.escape: The window to catch Sylas with Lux Q Light Binding is after Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down and before it comes back. Sylas W Kingslayer is also a mobility spell, so don't engage just because one of the two is down. Dodge the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, check which mobility spell remains, then look for a chance to kill him.
Sylas.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; use it to interrupt Sylas E Abscond / Abduct or when you have a chance to kill him. If you root Sylas with Lux Q Light Binding just after he jumps in, you'll have a chance to attack before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.laning: Lux has no mobility spell, so fight at the edge of your range, and first check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you're playing support, when pulling the lane, don't hit minions with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Sylas.phase: In the late game, enemies can get on top of you, so prioritize a safe position over damage.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chains that fly after the first dash are the real danger. If the chains hit, Sylas pulls himself to you and knocks you up, so don't waste Lux Q Light Binding in response to the first dash; dodge the chains or root Sylas after he engages. The crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes after a delay, so move out immediately even if you only get clipped by the first hit.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge sideways. Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb, since its stun can leave you open to follow-up attacks. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive. Xerath’s main damage is magic, so choose Mercury’s Treads and build magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: After Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, hit Lux Q Light Binding. With Lux E Lucent Singularity placed, use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Xerath.escape: Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility, so close the gap and hit Lux Q Light Binding to make it hard for him to escape.
Xerath.fight: Dodge sideways while Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, and close the gap. Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, bind him with Lux Q Light Binding and attack.
Xerath.laning: Instead of trying to dodge all of Xerath’s poke, farm while avoiding heavy damage and wait for him to run out of mana. Then push the wave and call your jungler. Conserve mana on Lux E Lucent Singularity, and use it to check bushes you have no vision of before entering.
Xerath.phase: Early on, focus on surviving Xerath’s long range and Lux’s low magic resistance. In the late game, focus on choosing a safe position over dealing damage.
Xerath.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a clear takedown.

Akali.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali’s main damage is magic and Lux has low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. Since Akali is an assassin, build Zhonya's Hourglass earlier too.
Akali.combo: After landing Lux Q Light Binding on Akali, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it immediately. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Akali.escape: Before Akali R Perfect Execution becomes available again, land Lux Q Light Binding to limit her escape options. Don’t go in hastily when only one of Akali’s mobility tools is down; she can still escape with the one she has left.
Akali.fight: Focus on dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip, and save Lux Q Light Binding to stop her engage or secure a kill rather than to poke. You can look for Lux Q Light Binding during the brief moment Akali becomes visible when re-entering Akali W Twilight Shroud.
Akali.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at maximum range, and check brushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throwing Lux E Lucent Singularity whenever it’s off cooldown will drain your mana, so choose when to poke. If you need to pull the lane as a support, use Lux E Lucent Singularity without overlapping it with minions.
Akali.phase: In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong. In the late game, prioritize positioning because Akali can get on top of you.
Akali.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Akali’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to shield them from damage. Use Lux R Final Spark for a sure finish or when you can hit multiple enemies in a line.
Akali.watch: Once Lux is marked, the second dash follows her as she tries to escape.

Anivia.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to hold on early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia’s main damage is magic, so Lux should build magic resistance first.
Anivia.combo: When going for Anivia, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate E → basic attack. Delay the E detonation so you can consume Lux P Illumination’s mark with two basic attacks.
Anivia.escape: When Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize are down, bind Anivia with Lux Q Light Binding and then go in. Anivia has no mobility, but Lux also has no ability to escape on her own, so don’t close the gap while those two abilities are available.
Anivia.fight: Trade at maximum range by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity, then using a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it for a chance to kill Anivia or to stop her approach. If you make Anivia use Anivia P Rebirth, that’s your chance to kill while she can’t revive again.
Anivia.laning: Lux has no escape ability, so play outside Anivia Q Flash Frost’s range. Check brushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and don’t cast E whenever it’s off cooldown so you don’t run out of mana.
Anivia.phase: In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as her ability power builds. In the late game, watch out for Anivia’s terrain control and prioritize Lux’s positioning.
Anivia.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop approaches with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to shield them from damage. Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit multiple enemies in a line or secure a sure finish.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost explodes and stuns if recast, so it’s safer for Lux to stay out of range from the start. If you’re hit by Q or are inside Anivia R Glacial Storm after it has grown large enough, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. On narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Ashe.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ashe’s damage is mostly physical and Lux has low armor, so build armor first.
Ashe.combo: When you have an angle to kill Ashe, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility to create distance on her own, so look for an opening to go in and land Lux Q Light Binding after Ashe W Volley is down. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, be mindful of the stun threat; keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active.
Ashe.fight: When Ashe W Volley is down, poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it for a kill opportunity to bind Ashe or to stop an engage.
Ashe.laning: Lux has no mobility and has low armor and health, so don’t stay within Ashe’s basic attack range for long and play at maximum range. When you need to pull the lane, hit only Ashe with Lux E Lucent Singularity; before entering a brush without vision, check it with this ability.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Lux can find a kill after landing Lux Q Light Binding, but it’s safer to avoid fighting while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. In the late game, focus on staying in a position where you can deal damage.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths Ashe may pass through with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Even if Ashe is behind your allies, Lux Q Light Binding can bind the first two targets it hits, so look for an angle to hit them together. Use Lux R Final Spark when enemies are lined up or you can secure a sure finish.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow used to poke, so dodge it by moving sideways and look to trade right after it’s down. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and don’t start a small skirmish from out of sight while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available.

Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Consider Morellonomicon if healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang becomes a problem.
Cassiopeia.combo: After landing Lux Q Light Binding, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Cassiopeia.escape: Right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere is your chance to close the distance. Cassiopeia has no ability to create distance on her own, so if you have an engage angle, root her first with Lux Q Light Binding. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun instead of continuing to deal damage from the front.
Cassiopeia.fight: Early on, poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity and use a basic attack after detonating it to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, don't continue the trade; keep your distance until the poison ends. Look for an angle to land Lux Q Light Binding before Cassiopeia gains movement speed.
Cassiopeia.laning: Don't use Lux Q Light Binding for poke; save it for a chance to kill or to stop Cassiopeia from approaching. Lux has no mobility, so play at max range and use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check brush with no vision.
Cassiopeia.phase: If you don't build a lead early, mid to late game favors Cassiopeia, so be especially careful with Lux's positioning later in the game.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop Cassiopeia's approach with Lux Q Light Binding, and block her path with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a definite finish.
Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you're poisoned, so get out of range and fight again after the poison ends. If you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.

Ekko.build: Ekko mainly deals magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Tenacity is important because being stunned by Ekko W Parallel Convergence and hit by his follow-up is dangerous. If an enemy assassin makes it hard to survive, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well.
Ekko.combo: If Ekko R Chronobreak is down and you hit Ekko with Lux Q Light Binding, place Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Delay the detonation so you can consume the Lux P Illumination mark with both basic attacks.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, his mobility spell is on cooldown, giving you a chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. If Ekko W Parallel Convergence is also down, it’s a good time to start a full fight.
Ekko.fight: For a short trade, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity and use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Ekko’s engage right after Ekko E Phase Dive and to set up a kill. You have an opening to fight in earnest while Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes you have no vision of first with Lux E Lucent Singularity. If you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, avoid its area, and stay clear of Ekko Q Timewinder’s return path. Lux E Lucent Singularity drains your mana if you cast it on cooldown, so choose a good angle to land it.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, Lux’s burst is strong as she builds ability power, but Ekko can close in, so prioritize positioning over damage.
Ekko.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Ekko’s engage with Ekko E Phase Dive. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to block his approach or escape route, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce clustered enemies or secure a kill.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of the marked area to avoid its stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and dodge its return path too. If you see Ekko’s afterimage behind him, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even when health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz mainly deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well to prepare for Fizz, an assassin, closing in.
Fizz.combo: Start with Lux Q Light Binding right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. Place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Fizz.escape: The key window to engage is after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. If he has also used Fizz Q Urchin Strike, he has no mobility left, so catch him with Lux Q Light Binding and attack.
Fizz.fight: If Fizz uses Fizz W Seastone Trident to last-hit but fails to secure the last hit, trade with him. Normally, poke by detonating Lux E Lucent Singularity and using a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, catch him with the Lux Q Light Binding you saved and follow up with burst.
Fizz.phase: In the early game, Lux can set up a kill by hitting Lux Q Light Binding, but look for an opening when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. In the mid-to-late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power. In the late game, hold your position so Fizz can’t close in.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies behind the frontline and make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first. When he engages, use Lux Q Light Binding to stop him, Lux E Lucent Singularity to block the path, and Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, focus him with your allies. Use Lux R Final Spark to secure a kill or pierce several enemies.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used to both engage and escape, so save Lux Q Light Binding until it’s down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from allies before the shark explodes. When Fizz uses Fizz Q Urchin Strike to follow up on the shark, place Lux E Lucent Singularity along his approach.

Galio.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads. Galio mainly deals magic damage, and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Galio.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and delay its detonation → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Don’t commit to this combo while Galio W Shield of Durand is charging.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down; check whether Galio R Hero’s Entrance is still on cooldown. After dodging Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt, hitting him with Lux Q Light Binding gives you a window where he’ll struggle to escape.
Galio.fight: Poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity at the edge of its range, then use a basic attack to consume the Lux P Illumination mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Galio E Justice Punch or set up a kill. While Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don’t commit your damage; move out of taunt range.
Galio.laning: Galio is melee and uses a lot of mana, so poke from range and make him use his abilities to clear the wave. When Galio is low on mana, push the wave to limit his opportunity to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance. If you need to pull the wave, don’t overlap Lux E Lucent Singularity with minions; check bushes you have no vision of with the ability first.
Galio.phase: In the mid-to-late game, Lux’s burst becomes strong as she builds ability power. In the late game, positioning to keep your distance matters more than damage.
Galio.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline. Use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Galio’s engage and Lux E Lucent Singularity to block paths. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage, and use Lux R Final Spark to hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill. Move out of range when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Galio.watch: Galio E Justice Punch dashes in and knocks you up, so dodge when you see him step back to wind up, then use Lux Q Light Binding to stop his engage. When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, it reduces damage he takes and extends the taunt, so don’t commit your damage; walk out of range. Avoid where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap, and immediately leave the area when you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance.

Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Irelia’s main source of physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Irelia.combo: Catch Irelia with Lux Q Light Binding after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down. If you have a kill opportunity, place Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Irelia.escape: The moment Irelia Q Bladesurge is used without resetting is your chance to hit Lux Q Light Binding. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, you can close the distance and attack, but Lux has no mobility, so stay at the edge of your range.
Irelia.fight: When Irelia can engage with Irelia Q Bladesurge, don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop her engage. Keep your distance and poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume the Illumination mark if it hits.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and take a step back when minions are about to die. Keep Lux E Lucent Singularity’s mana cost in mind, and use it to check bushes you have no vision of before entering.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, watch for Irelia’s engage and prioritize positioning over damage.
Irelia.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and use Lux Q Light Binding to stop Irelia’s engage, then Lux E Lucent Singularity to block her approach. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit Irelia and other enemies in a line.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close in, making it dangerous. Create distance when minions are about to die, and position to dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve becomes a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Karma.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and hold it → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. Account for Lux R Final Spark’s cast delay and hit before the root wears off. Look for this combo after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire expires.
Karma.escape: Look for a chance to catch Karma with Lux Q Light Binding when Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has expired. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects first, don’t engage; create distance before the root lands. When retreating, throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier in the direction you’re running so the returning shield reaches you sooner.
Karma.fight: Usually, hit the enemy with Lux E Lucent Singularity, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; use it when Karma W Focused Resolve is down or when you need to stop an engage. Don’t deal burst damage immediately after Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire shields a target; fight after the shield expires.
Karma.laning: Lux has no mobility, so prioritize keeping your distance at maximum range. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision, and reposition so Karma can’t charge Karma R Mantra by hitting you with her abilities. As support, if you need to pull the wave, cast Lux E Lucent Singularity so it doesn’t hit minions.
Karma.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill if Lux Q Light Binding lands, but first keep enough distance to avoid Karma’s poke and root. In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst gets stronger as she builds ability power. In the late game, positioning so you can’t be caught matters more than damage.
Karma.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block routes with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, first create distance to make her use it, then engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire expires. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce clustered enemies or secure a sure finish.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame’s slow and area damage are dangerous. If you’re hit by the zone from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, walk out of it immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before the root lands. If you keep getting hit by Karma’s abilities, Karma P Gathering Fire lets her use Karma R Mantra again sooner, so move out of range or behind minions.

Kassadin.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance. If Kassadin’s engage as an assassin is threatening, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Kassadin.combo: Then, with Lux E Lucent Singularity placed, cast Lux R Final Spark, followed by basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Kassadin.escape: Once Kassadin E Force Pulse is down, you’re less likely to be slowed. The moment repeated casts of Kassadin R Riftwalk leave him out of mana is also a chance to counterattack.
Kassadin.fight: Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop Kassadin’s engage or set up a kill. Focus your damage when Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down.
Kassadin.laning: When clearing the wave, use your abilities outside Kassadin’s range when possible so you don’t reduce Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity every time it’s available will leave you out of mana, so use it when needed.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, watch for Kassadin entering from behind and prioritize Lux’s positioning over damage.
Kassadin.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop Kassadin’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block the approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark for a sure finish or when you can hit several enemies in a line.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Lux’s magic poke, so deal damage while Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down. Also watch out for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse.

Leblanc.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to prepare for the risk of being caught by an assassin.
Leblanc.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding lands after LeBlanc W Distortion has been used, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Lux R Final Spark has a cast delay, so sequence the combo quickly to fire it before the root wears off.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc W Distortion is down is your chance to close the distance. Hit her with Lux Q Light Binding to stop her engage. Before following further, make sure LeBlanc W Distortion’s return has already been used or its return window has passed. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down, you can fight with less risk of being rooted.
Leblanc.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to stop LeBlanc W Distortion’s engage or set up a kill. Right after you make LeBlanc use LeBlanc W Distortion is your chance to counterattack with Lux Q Light Binding.
Leblanc.laning: Lux has no mobility, so manage your distance at maximum range. If LeBlanc pushes the wave and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately. In a side lane, secure river vision before moving forward. Use Lux E Lucent Singularity to check bushes without vision, but don’t cast it every time it’s up or you’ll run out of mana.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, Lux can look for a kill if Lux Q Light Binding lands, but prioritize keeping your distance to avoid LeBlanc W Distortion and her root combo. In the mid to late game, Lux’s burst gets stronger as she builds ability power, but in the late game, avoid positions where LeBlanc can reach you.
Leblanc.teamfight: Stay behind your team’s frontline, stop LeBlanc’s engage with Lux Q Light Binding, and block the approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark for a sure finish or when you can hit several enemies in a line.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is still on you, her next ability combo will be stronger, so back away and wait for the mark to disappear. Create distance when LeBlanc W Distortion dashes in. If you’re hit by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, move out of its range before the root lands. If LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, check which one is actually attacking before using your abilities.

Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Malzahar deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Malzahar.combo: If Malzahar P Void Shift is down, use Lux Q Light Binding → place and hold Lux E Lucent Singularity → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack. If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Lux Q Light Binding, then look for the combo when your binding is available again.
Malzahar.escape: When Malzahar Q Call of the Void misses or is down and Malzahar P Void Shift is also gone, you have a chance to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. Malzahar has no mobility, but Lux has no ability to escape either, so don't close the distance alone while Malzahar R Nether Grasp is a threat.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Lux Q Light Binding, then look for a binding and burst damage while Void Shift is absent. For regular trades, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination.
Malzahar.laning: Stay away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, then move again once the wave is cleared. Early on, push or apply pressure to limit Malzahar's chances to build Malzahar W Void Swarm. If Malzahar has pushed the wave, look for a chance to take him down with your jungler after breaking Void Shift. Save Lux Q Light Binding for kill opportunities and stopping engages; don't use it to poke.
Malzahar.phase: Early on, Lux applies pressure to limit Malzahar's chances to build Malzahar W Void Swarm. In the mid to late game, Lux's burst damage gets stronger, but Malzahar also grows stronger over time. In the late game, prioritize Lux's positioning over damage.
Malzahar.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can hit several enemies in a line or secure a kill.
Malzahar.watch: If a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to the nearest enemy, so move away from that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between its two portals to avoid the silence. Malzahar R Nether Grasp suppresses and deals damage based on maximum health, and Lux W Prismatic Barrier can't remove the suppression. Don't pass through areas without vision alone when Malzahar can use it.

Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots early. Mel deals mostly magic damage, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: After Mel W Rebuttal is down, root her with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then consume Lux P Illumination's mark in this order: Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
Mel.escape: Dodge Mel E Solar Snare to the side to avoid its root, then go in when Mel W Rebuttal is down. Mel has no mobility, so if Lux Q Light Binding hits during that window, she will have a hard time getting away.
Mel.fight: To poke, place Lux E Lucent Singularity on Mel, detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop Mel from engaging. Bait out Mel W Rebuttal with a basic attack, or block her path with a Lux E Lucent Singularity you've already placed, then look for a binding angle.
Mel.laning: Apply pressure from the start to limit Mel's chances to build growth stacks. Lux has no mobility, so fight at the edge of your range, and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When pulling the wave, hit only Mel with Lux E Lucent Singularity; overlap it with minions only when you need to push.
Mel.phase: From the start, Lux uses poke and roots to keep Mel down and delay her growth. Mel gets stronger as stacks build on Mel R Golden Eclipse, so don't give her too much time.
Mel.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward grouped allies. Once Mel W Rebuttal is down, look for an angle to hit clustered enemies in a line with Lux R Final Spark.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles for a brief moment, so don't cast Lux Q Light Binding when it looks like she's about to activate it. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you are hit by its center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow up, so sidestep it. If you've been hit several times and Overwhelm has stacked up, back off even if you still have health. After a fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.

Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Orianna's damage is mainly magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Orianna.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and leave it in place → Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so look for an angle to hit her with Lux Q Light Binding right after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her. Watch out for Orianna R Command: Shockwave near the ball, and approach after that ability and Orianna W Command: Dissonance are down.
Orianna.fight: The chance to trade comes right after Orianna uses Orianna Q Command: Attack to move the ball away from herself. Poke with Lux E Lucent Singularity and consume Lux P Illumination's mark with one attack, but don't take an extended attack trade against Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill or to stop an approach instead of using it to poke. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity every time it's up will drain your mana, so use it for necessary poke.
Orianna.phase: Orianna has low defensive stats early, so hitting her with Lux Q Light Binding can set up a kill, but don't trade attacks for long because of Orianna P Clockwork Windup. Later, focus on safe positioning over Lux's damage.
Orianna.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt approaches with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. Avoid the area around Orianna's ball, and look for an angle to pierce multiple enemies or secure a kill with Lux R Final Spark.
Orianna.watch: Near Orianna's ball, Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in, so position based on the ball rather than Orianna herself. Watch out for the area damage from Orianna Q Command: Attack and the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance. If damage is expected, absorb it with Lux W Prismatic Barrier.

Pantheon.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, and Lux has low armor, so build armor first.
Pantheon.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and leave it in place → Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack.
Pantheon.escape: The window to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is back up. Hit Pantheon with Lux Q Light Binding then to prevent him from disengaging.
Pantheon.fight: Usually, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then poke with an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Save Lux Q Light Binding instead of using it to poke; hold it to interrupt Pantheon W Shield Vault's engage or set up a kill. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, wait to detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity or look for an angle from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Keep a minion between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you need to pull the wave, avoid letting Lux E Lucent Singularity hit minions.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls off later, but Lux should hold a safe position to avoid being caught.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline and interrupt Pantheon's engage with Lux Q Light Binding, then block his approach with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark to hit grouped enemies in a line or to secure a kill.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so be careful not to enter its range. When Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear at long range to poke, keep a minion between you. If you see the landing warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end instead of dealing damage from the front.

Ryze.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Ryze's main damage is magic, and Lux has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: After hitting Ryze with Lux Q Light Binding, place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, so still look for an angle to bind him. If Ryze is casting Ryze R Realm Warp, Lux Q Light Binding can interrupt it.
Ryze.fight: For a short trade, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use an attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Don't use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it to interrupt Ryze's engage or set up a kill.
Ryze.laning: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, so pressure him before he gets his items to slow his growth. Lux has no mobility, so play at the edge of your range and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Casting Lux E Lucent Singularity every time it's up will drain your mana, so choose an opening to poke.
Ryze.phase: Ryze lacks mana and damage early, giving Lux a chance to pressure him in lane. Later, the enemy can get on top of you, so Lux should prioritize positioning over damage.
Ryze.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, interrupt Ryze's approach or Ryze R Realm Warp cast with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies to block damage. Use Lux R Final Spark to secure a kill or hit multiple enemies in a line.
Ryze.watch: If you're hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, watch out for the root from Ryze W Rune Prison and an empowered Ryze Q Overload. If you get marked, move away from allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears, while dodging Ryze E Spell Flux first.

Talon.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Talon's damage is physical, so build armor first, and rush Zhonya's Hourglass to prepare for the threat of an assassin catching you. Mix in penetration because Lux's magic damage is blocked by Talon's high magic resistance.
Talon.combo: When you have a chance to kill Talon, root him with Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity, but don't detonate it right away. Then use Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark.
Talon.escape: The moment after you make Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your window to catch him with Lux Q Light Binding. If Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used, that's also a chance to counterattack; if it's still available, don't chase.
Talon.fight: When poking, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination's mark. Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, root him with Lux Q Light Binding to get a chance to counterattack. If Lux Q Light Binding misses, Lux is left exposed, so don't use it first to poke.
Talon.laning: Push the wave first so Talon doesn't level up before you, share position information to prepare for Talon's roams, and place vision along jungle routes. Check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Talon.phase: Talon's influence falls off in the late game, but Lux still needs to protect her positioning so an assassin can't catch her.
Talon.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, root Talon as he dives in with Lux Q Light Binding, and block his entry path with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Cast Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your clustered allies to block damage. If Talon gets into your backline, group with your allies and layer crowd control. Use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce several enemies or finish them off for sure.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you the first time, move out of the return path to prevent his passive from stacking and triggering its bleed. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can escape with stealth, so don't chase recklessly.

TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and Lux's magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: For a kill, use Lux Q Light Binding → place Lux E Lucent Singularity and keep it active → Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack.
TwistedFate.escape: Your opportunity comes right after Twisted Fate uses his gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card.
TwistedFate.fight: When poking, place Lux E Lucent Singularity and detonate it, then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay out of his basic attack range. Save Lux Q Light Binding for a kill opportunity or to stop an engage.
TwistedFate.laning: Lux has no mobility and is vulnerable to ambushes, so fight at the edge of your range and check bushes you have no vision of with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Reduce the poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards by standing behind minions, and use Lux E Lucent Singularity only when needed so you don't run out of mana.
TwistedFate.phase: At the same time, watch for Twisted Fate to roam. In the mid to late game, make the most of Lux’s burst as your ability power stacks up. In the late game, prioritize a safe position over damage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity, and throw Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward your grouped allies. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being used and he’s in range, stop his movement with Lux Q Light Binding. Use Lux R Final Spark to secure a clear takedown or hit multiple enemies in a line.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range.

Veigar.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Veigar's main damage is magic, and Lux's magic resistance is on the low side, so build magic resistance first.
Veigar.combo: If Veigar E Event Horizon is down and you have an angle to hit Lux Q Light Binding, bind him, then place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Follow with Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Veigar.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Veigar has no ability to create distance, so close the gap and bind him with Lux Q Light Binding.
Veigar.fight: Pressure Veigar early, but for poke, detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity and then use a basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark. Keep moving even while landing basic attacks to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter. Don’t use Lux Q Light Binding to poke; save it for a kill opportunity after Veigar E Event Horizon is down.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike pierces only the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to avoid it. When you need to pull the wave, hit only Veigar with Lux E Lucent Singularity instead of overlapping it with minions.
Veigar.phase: In the late game, Veigar’s permanent scaling makes the matchup harder as time goes on, so check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used before fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: Stay behind your frontline, stop engages with Lux Q Light Binding, and block paths with Lux E Lucent Singularity. Protect your grouped allies by throwing Lux W Prismatic Barrier toward them, and use Lux R Final Spark when you can pierce grouped enemies in a line. Before fighting over an objective, check Veigar’s position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used.
Veigar.watch: Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and dodge sideways. If trapped inside Veigar E Event Horizon, don't cross the edge; move within it and hold out until it disappears. If health drops below half, move out of range while watching for Veigar R Primordial Burst, which grows stronger in proportion to missing health.

Velkoz.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Vel'Koz's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Resistance can't block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, so your priority is to avoid being hit by consecutive abilities.
Velkoz.combo: After Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, hit Lux Q Light Binding and place Lux E Lucent Singularity without detonating it right away. Follow with Lux R Final Spark → basic attack → detonate Lux E Lucent Singularity → basic attack to consume Lux P Illumination’s mark.
Velkoz.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Vel’Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down. Vel’Koz has no mobility, so close the gap and hit Lux Q Light Binding to make it hard for him to escape.
